name: production-line-web
description: Self-hosted, LAN-only scheduling app for shared 3D printers

scripts.dev: npm run build -w packages/shared && concurrently -n shared,server,client -c blue,green,magenta "npm run dev -w packages/shared" "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/shared && npm run build -w client && node scripts/copy-client.mjs && npm run build -w server
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w packages/shared && tsc -p server/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p client/tsconfig.json --noEmit
